Metadata.title: Mumbai Local · Indian Food
Metadata.description: Street-food-stall meets suburban railway. Bombay classics — butter chicken, pav bhaji, thalis — served hot off the platform.

Footer.blurb: A Bombay street kitchen on a Berlin platform. Come hungry, leave on the next train.

CTA.title: Grab a table before the rush
CTA.body: Weekends fill up fast. Reserve online or call the kitchen — we'll keep the chai warm.

hero.sub: Fast, loud, full of flavour — the food you'd eat between trains at Churchgate, plated for the long stay.

menu.title: Every line on the menu
menu.intro: Six platforms, one kitchen. Tap a category and follow the flavour — spice levels marked, prices in euro.

spotlight.title: The Thali. All lines, one plate.
spotlight.body: Can't decide? Ride the whole network. A rotating spread of dal, paneer, curry, rice, sabji and chutney — the full Mumbai Local in fifteen little bowls.

meta.title: About Us
meta.description: The story behind Mumbai Local — a Bombay street kitchen serving Indian classics from a Berlin platform.

About.title: From the 8:12 Local
About.intro: Mumbai Local started as a memory: the smell of pav bhaji drifting across a crowded platform at rush hour. We plated that memory.
About.story1: Mumbai's suburban trains carry millions every day, and every station has its own stall — the vada pav guy, the cutting-chai chaiwala, the poha counter that's gone by nine. That energy is the whole idea behind our kitchen.
About.story2: We cook the classics the way they're made back home: spices ground fresh, meats marinated overnight, no shortcuts. Then we set them down on a proper table, at an easy pace — the flavours of the platform, without the rush.
About.quote: Come hungry, leave on the next train.

stop1.title: Sourced
stop1.body: Spices and lentils from North India, produce from the market that morning.

stop2.title: Marinated
stop2.body: Meats rest up to twelve hours so the masala reaches the bone.

stop3.title: Fired
stop3.body: Cooked to order over high heat — the way a street stall does it.

stop4.title: Served
stop4.body: Plated hot with basmati, salad, papadam and chutney.

value1.title: Real spice
value1.body: Every masala is ground in-house. Heat levels are marked so you ride the right line.

value2.title: Generous plates
value2.body: Portions built for sharing — thalis, biryanis and breads made to pass around.

value3.title: Veg-first
value3.body: Half the board is vegetarian or vegan, and it's never an afterthought.
